latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video to Text AI Free — fast, no-cost AI video transcription for content creators.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (≤500MB) and convert video speech to accurate text transcripts
- Simple workflow: upload → transcribe → export and download 1080p MP4 with transcript overlay
- Automatic free token generation (100 credits/7 days); no sign-up required
- Built-in cloud rendering: process jobs in 30–90 seconds per video
- Clear error handling for file size, type, and authentication issues
- Designed for creators, students, and journalists needing quick, reliable transcripts without extra steps
